# tcpshield_backend_set (Resource)

A backend set: the origin servers (`host:port`) a domain or Bedrock tunnel forwards traffic to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tcpshield_backend_set" "lobby" {
  network_id     = tcpshield_network.main.id
  name           = "lobby"
  backends       = ["203.0.113.10:25565", "203.0.113.11:25565"]
  proxy_protocol = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backends` (List of String) Origin servers as `host:port`, e.g. `203.0.113.10:25565`.
- `name` (String) Backend set name.
- `network_id` (Number) Network the backend set belongs to.

### Optional

- `load_balancing_mode` (Number) Load balancing mode, as the panel's numeric code.
- `proxy_protocol` (Boolean) Send the PROXY protocol header to the backends.
- `vulcan_ac_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the Vulcan anti-cheat integration.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric backend set id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tcpshield_backend_set.lobby <network_id>/<backend_set_id>
```
